title: Persistent Retrieval for Conversational Agents: A Study of Retrieval Efficiency
abstract: arXiv:2611.07899v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conversational agents can retrieve information directly or delegate retrieval to a subagent. This design choice affects how retrieval history is maintained, what context each model call receives, and what information must be re-retrieved in follow-up questions. We compare three designs: skill-based retrieval in the main agent, a non-persistent retrieval subagent that generates a findings response, and our persistent retrieval subagent, which maintains retrieval history across turns and returns retrieved evidence directly to the main agent. Our approach also allows the main agent to request corrections from the same subagent.   We evaluate the three designs on enterprise questions posed independently, within shared conversations, and as dependent follow-ups. Across five multi-turn settings, our approach uses 43.3% fewer recorded agent-model tokens and incurs 45.0% lower estimated API cost than skill-based retrieval, while reducing average

translated_title: 面向对话代理的持久化检索：检索效率研究
translated_abstract: 对话代理可以直接检索信息，也可以将检索任务委托给子代理。这一设计选择会影响检索历史的维护方式、每次模型调用所接收的上下文，以及在后续问题中需要重新检索哪些信息。我们比较了三种设计：主代理中基于技能（skill-based）的检索、生成调查结果回复的非持久化检索子代理，以及我们提出的持久化检索子代理——该子代理跨轮次维护检索历史，并将检索到的证据直接返回给主代理。我们的方法还允许主代理向同一个子代理请求修正。我们在独立提出的企业问题、共享对话中的问题以及依赖性后续问题上对这三种设计进行了评估。在五个多轮设置中，与基于技能的检索相比，我们的方法记录的代理-模型token用量减少43.3%，预估API成本降低45.0%，同时降低了平均
tldr: 提出一种跨轮次维护检索历史并将检索证据直接返回主代理的持久化检索子代理设计，相比基于技能的检索可减少43.3%的token用量和45.0%的预估API成本。
en_tdlr: Proposes a persistent retrieval subagent that maintains retrieval history across turns and directly returns retrieved evidence to the main agent, cutting recorded agent-model tokens by 43.3% and estimated API cost by 45.0% compared to skill-based retrieval.
